We’ve got answers. And we think you’re going to like them. Don’t see your question? Contact us today —we’ll be happy to help! How long does the process take? From your first quote to your final install, the whole process takes about 10–14 weeks. Here’s how it works: We measure your windows 1–3 weeks after you give us the green light. Then your custom windows are built. Once they arrive, our install team gets them in—usually in one day, maybe two for big jobs. How do you compare to brands like Pella? Our premium, energy-efficient windows are often a fraction of the cost of Pella and other brands. Why? You’re not paying for showroom overhead, just great windows and great service. What are the potential downsides? Replacement windows slightly reduce your visible glass area by an inch or two. But you’ll get back better insulation, quieter rooms, and a house that feels and looks better. The trade’s well worth it! When should you consider replacing your windows? Tell tale signs that it may be time for new windows? When they’re hard to open, drafty, look old, or don’t regulate the temperature of your home well. Or anytime you want to improve your energy bills, comfort or curb appeal! How long does the warranty last? As a national supplier for Alside, our windows are covered by Alside’s Limited Lifetime Warranty. Most standard windows have a lifetime warranty, including glass breakage!
